bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears took sole possession of first place in the NFC North after beating the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in a turnover-filled Week 9 game, with the Minnesota Vikings' loss to the Buffalo Bills helping Chicago's standing, though the win was overshadowed by Caleb Williams throwing four interceptions and wide receiver Luther Burden exiting with a concussion, as confirmed by head coach Ben Johnson . Despite the sloppy performance, the Bears survived a chaotic game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to take the top spot in the NFC North , while also dealing with ongoing trade deadline buzz involving names like Khalil Mack and newly acquired defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made a move ahead of the NFL trade deadline by trading a sixth-round pick to the New York Jets for safety Andre Cisco , addressing a need in the secondary as the team awaits the return of an injured Kerby Joseph. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are facing a major setback at running back after star running back Josh Jacobs could miss the next three weeks as he undergoes surgery to repair a fractured finger suffered in the Packers' Week 9 win over the New England Patriots . With Jacobs sidelined, the team is now exploring roster moves at the position while looking ahead to a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings at Lambeau Field on Sunday, November 15.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings fell to the Buffalo Bills 23-6 on Monday Night Football, dropping their record to 6-2, with Carson Wentz struggling badly in place of the injured Kyler Murray (hamstring). With Tuesday's trade deadline looming, insider Jordan Schultz reported the Vikings are expected to try to make a quarterback trade, with Kirk Cousins and Daniel Jones among the most likely available names.
